```diff
+ /**
+  * Analytics tracking service for Anemoia.
+  * Sends anonymous page-view and tool-usage events to the backend.
+  */
+ 
+ const API_BASE =
+   import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL?.replace(/\/api\/?$/, '') ||
+   (window.location.hostname === 'localhost'
+     ? 'http://localhost:8000'
+     : 'https://anemoia-api.onrender.com');
+ 
+ // ── Visitor fingerprint (stable per browser, no PII) ──
+ function getVisitorId(): string {
+   let id = localStorage.getItem('anemo_vid');
+   if (!id) {
+     id = crypto.randomUUID?.() ?? &#96;${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}&#96;;
+     localStorage.setItem('anemo_vid', id);
+   }
+   return id;
+ }
+ 
+ function getSessionId(): string {
+   let id = sessionStorage.getItem('anemo_sid');
+   if (!id) {
+     id = crypto.randomUUID?.() ?? &#96;${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}&#96;;
+     sessionStorage.setItem('anemo_sid', id);
+   }
+   return id;
+ }
+ 
+ // ── Device detection ──
+ function getDeviceType(): 'desktop' | 'mobile' | 'tablet' {
+   const ua = navigator.userAgent.toLowerCase();
+   if (/ipad|tablet|playbook|silk/i.test(ua) || (ua.includes('android') &amp;&amp; !ua.includes('mobile'))) {
+     return 'tablet';
+   }
+   if (/iphone|ipod|android.*mobile|windows phone|blackberry|bb10|opera mini|iemobile/i.test(ua)) {
+     return 'mobile';
+   }
+   return 'desktop';
+ }
+ 
+ function getBrowser(): string {
+   const ua = navigator.userAgent;
+   if (ua.includes('Firefox/')) return 'Firefox';
+   if (ua.includes('Edg/')) return 'Edge';
+   if (ua.includes('OPR/') || ua.includes('Opera')) return 'Opera';
+   if (ua.includes('Brave')) return 'Brave';
+   if (ua.includes('Chrome/') &amp;&amp; ua.includes('Safari/')) return 'Chrome';
+   if (ua.includes('Safari/') &amp;&amp; !ua.includes('Chrome')) return 'Safari';
+   if (ua.includes('MSIE') || ua.includes('Trident')) return 'IE';
+   return 'Other';
+ }
+ 
+ function getOS(): string {
+   const ua = navigator.userAgent;
+   if (ua.includes('Win')) return 'Windows';
+   if (ua.includes('Mac')) return 'macOS';
+   if (ua.includes('Linux') &amp;&amp; ua.includes('Android')) return 'Android';
+   if (ua.includes('Linux')) return 'Linux';
+   if (ua.includes('iPhone') || ua.includes('iPad')) return 'iOS';
+   if (ua.includes('CrOS')) return 'ChromeOS';
+   return 'Other';
+ }
+ 
+ // ── UTM params ──
+ function getUtmParams() {
+   const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
+   return {
+     utm_source: params.get('utm_source') || undefined,
+     utm_medium: params.get('utm_medium') || undefined,
+     utm_campaign: params.get('utm_campaign') || undefined,
+   };
+ }
+ 
+ // ── Tool name mapping (mirrors backend) ──
+ const TOOL_ROUTES: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {
+   '/depth-map': '3D Depth Mapping',
+   '/pose-estimation': 'Pose Estimation',
+   '/upscaler': 'AI Upscaling',
+   '/sharp': 'SHARP 3D Generator',
+   '/splat-viewer': '3D Splat Viewer',
+   '/compare': 'Image Comparison',
+   '/subtitle': 'Video Caption Studio',
+   '/face-swap': 'Face Swap AI',
+   '/ascii-video-converter': 'ASCII Video Converter',
+   '/image-chat': 'Gemini Image Chat',
+   '/triangle-splatting': 'Triangle Splatting',
+   '/doom': 'DOOM',
+   '/anime-gallery': 'Anime Gallery',
+   '/synthid-remover': 'SynthID Remover',
+   '/video-object-remover': 'Video Object Remover',
+ };
+ 
+ function getToolName(path: string): string | undefined {
+   for (const [route, name] of Object.entries(TOOL_ROUTES)) {
+     if (path.startsWith(route)) return name;
+   }
+   return undefined;
+ }
+ 
+ // ── Track event ──
+ let _lastTrackedPath = '';
+ let _pageEnterTime = Date.now();
+ 
+ export async function trackPageView(path: string, userEmail?: string | null) {
+   // Debounce duplicate calls for the same path
+   if (path === _lastTrackedPath) return;
+ 
+   // Calculate duration on previous page
+   const durationSeconds = _lastTrackedPath ? (Date.now() - _pageEnterTime) / 1000 : undefined;
+ 
+   _lastTrackedPath = path;
+   _pageEnterTime = Date.now();
+ 
+   const utm = getUtmParams();
+   const toolName = getToolName(path);
+ 
+   const payload: Record&lt;string, unknown&gt; = {
+     page_path: path,
+     tool_name: toolName,
+     visitor_id: getVisitorId(),
+     session_id: getSessionId(),
+     user_email: userEmail || undefined,
+     device_type: getDeviceType(),
+     browser: getBrowser(),
+     os: getOS(),
+     screen_width: window.screen.width,
+     screen_height: window.screen.height,
+     referrer: document.referrer || undefined,
+     ...utm,
+     duration_seconds: durationSeconds,
+   };
+ 
+   // Fire-and-forget
+   try {
+     await fetch(&#96;${API_BASE}/api/analytics/track&#96;, {
+       method: 'POST',
+       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+       body: JSON.stringify(payload),
+     });
+   } catch {
+     // Silently fail – analytics should never break the app
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ // ── Dashboard data fetcher ──
+ export interface AnalyticsDashboardData {
+   period: string;
+   start_date: string;
+   summary: {
+     total_events: number;
+     unique_visitors: number;
+     total_page_views: number;
+     total_tool_uses: number;
+   };
+   daily_visitors: { date: string; visitors: number; events: number }[];
+   tool_usage: { tool: string; count: number; unique_users: number }[];
+   device_breakdown: { device: string; count: number }[];
+   browser_breakdown: { browser: string; count: number }[];
+   os_breakdown: { os: string; count: number }[];
+   country_breakdown: { country: string; country_code: string; count: number; unique_visitors: number }[];
+   top_pages: { page: string; count: number; unique_visitors: number }[];
+   top_referrers: { referrer: string; count: number }[];
+   recent_events: {

+     event_type: string;
+     page_path: string;
+     tool_name: string | null;
+     device_type: string | null;
+     browser: string | null;
+     os: string | null;
+     country: string | null;
+     city: string | null;
+     referrer: string | null;
+     created_at: string | null;
+   }[];
+ }
+ 
+ export async function fetchDashboardData(
+   adminEmail: string,
+   period: string = '30d',
+ ): Promise&lt;AnalyticsDashboardData&gt; {
+   const resp = await fetch(
+     &#96;${API_BASE}/api/analytics/dashboard?admin_email=${encodeURIComponent(adminEmail)}&amp;period=${period}&#96;,
+   );
+   if (!resp.ok) {
+     throw new Error(&#96;Dashboard API returned ${resp.status}: ${await resp.text()}&#96;);
+   }
+   return resp.json();
+ }
```

```diff
+   return String.fromCodePoint(...codePoints);

+ // ── Compact number formatter ──

+ // ── Sparkline mini bar chart component ──
+ const MiniBarChart = ({ data, color = '#06b6d4', height = 80 }: { data: number[]; color?: string; height?: number }) =&gt; {
+   if (!data.length) return null;
+   const max = Math.max(...data, 1);
+   const barWidth = Math.max(2, Math.min(12, 400 / data.length - 1));
+   const totalWidth = data.length * (barWidth + 1);
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;svg width="100%" height={height} viewBox={&#96;0 0 ${totalWidth} ${height}&#96;} preserveAspectRatio="none"&gt;
+       {data.map((val, i) =&gt; {
+         const barHeight = (val / max) * (height - 4);
+         return (
+           &lt;rect
+             key={i}
+             x={i * (barWidth + 1)}
+             y={height - barHeight - 2}
+             width={barWidth}
+             height={barHeight}
+             rx={1}
+             fill={color}
+             opacity={0.7 + 0.3 * (val / max)}
+           /&gt;
+         );
+       })}
+     &lt;/svg&gt;
+   );
+ };
```

```diff
+     utm_campaign = Column(String(100), nullable=True)
```

```diff
- 
+ const PERIODS = [
+   { label: '7D', value: '7d' },
+   { label: '30D', value: '30d' },
+   { label: '90D', value: '90d' },
+   { label: '1Y', value: '365d' },
+   { label: 'ALL', value: 'all' },
+ ];
+ 
+ const TOOL_COLORS: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {
+   '3D Depth Mapping': '#06b6d4',
+   'Pose Estimation': '#8b5cf6',
+   'AI Upscaling': '#10b981',
+   'SHARP 3D Generator': '#f59e0b',
+   '3D Splat Viewer': '#3b82f6',
+   'Image Comparison': '#ec4899',
+   'Video Caption Studio': '#6366f1',
+   'Face Swap AI': '#14b8a6',
+   'ASCII Video Converter': '#f97316',
+   'Gemini Image Chat': '#a855f7',
+   'Triangle Splatting': '#22d3ee',
+   'DOOM': '#ef4444',
+   'Anime Gallery': '#84cc16',
+   'SynthID Remover': '#0ea5e9',
+   'Video Object Remover': '#f43f5e',
+ };
+ 
+ // ── Helpers ──
+ function countryFlag(code: string): string {
+   if (!code || code.length !== 2 || code === '??') return '🌍';
+   const codePoints = [...code.toUpperCase()].map((c) =&gt; 0x1f1e6 - 65 + c.charCodeAt(0));
+   return String.fromCodePoint(...codePoints);
+ }
+ 
+ function fmtNum(n: number): string {
+   if (n &gt;= 1_000_000) return (n / 1_000_000).toFixed(1) + 'M';
+   if (n &gt;= 10_000) return (n / 1_000).toFixed(0) + 'K';
+   if (n &gt;= 1_000) return (n / 1_000).toFixed(1) + 'K';
+   return n.toLocaleString();
+ }
+ 
+ function deviceEmoji(type: string): string {
+   const t = type?.toLowerCase() || '';
+   if (t === 'mobile') return '📱';
+   if (t === 'tablet') return '📟';
+   if (t === 'desktop') return '🖥️';
+   return '❓';
+ }
+ 
+ function timeAgo(dateStr: string): string {
+   const diff = Date.now() - new Date(dateStr).getTime();
+   const mins = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
+   if (mins &lt; 1) return 'just now';
+   if (mins &lt; 60) return &#96;${mins}m ago&#96;;
+   const hrs = Math.floor(mins / 60);
+   if (hrs &lt; 24) return &#96;${hrs}h ago&#96;;
+   const days = Math.floor(hrs / 24);
+   return &#96;${days}d ago&#96;;
+ }
+ 
+ // ── Sparkline SVG chart ──
+ const SparkArea = ({
+   data,
+   color = '#06b6d4',
+   height = 80,
+   showDots = false,
+   label,
+ }: {
+   data: number[];
+   color?: string;
+   height?: number;
+   showDots?: boolean;
+   label?: string;
+ }) =&gt; {
+   if (!data.length) return &lt;div className="h-20 flex items-center justify-center text-gray-700 text-sm"&gt;No data&lt;/div&gt;;
+   const max = Math.max(...data, 1);
+   const w = 600;
+   const pad = 2;
+   const step = (w - pad * 2) / Math.max(data.length - 1, 1);
+ 
+   const points = data.map((v, i) =&gt; {
+     const x = pad + i * step;
+     const y = height - pad - ((v / max) * (height - pad * 2));
+     return { x, y, v };
+   });
+ 
+   const linePath = points.map((p, i) =&gt; &#96;${i === 0 ? 'M' : 'L'}${p.x},${p.y}&#96;).join(' ');
+   const areaPath = &#96;${linePath} L${points[points.length - 1].x},${height} L${points[0].x},${height} Z&#96;;
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className="relative"&gt;
+       {label &amp;&amp; &lt;div className="absolute top-0 left-0 text-[10px] text-gray-600 font-mono"&gt;{label}&lt;/div&gt;}
+       &lt;svg width="100%" height={height} viewBox={&#96;0 0 ${w} ${height}&#96;} preserveAspectRatio="none" className="overflow-visible"&gt;
+         &lt;defs&gt;
+           &lt;linearGradient id={&#96;grad-${color.replace('#', '')}&#96;} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"&gt;
+             &lt;stop offset="0%" stopColor={color} stopOpacity="0.3" /&gt;
+             &lt;stop offset="100%" stopColor={color} stopOpacity="0.02" /&gt;
+           &lt;/linearGradient&gt;
+         &lt;/defs&gt;
+         &lt;path d={areaPath} fill={&#96;url(#grad-${color.replace('#', '')})&#96;} /&gt;
+         &lt;path d={linePath} fill="none" stroke={color} strokeWidth="2" strokeLinejoin="round" /&gt;
+         {showDots &amp;&amp;
+           points.map((p, i) =&gt; (
+             &lt;circle key={i} cx={p.x} cy={p.y} r="3" fill={color} opacity={i === points.length - 1 ? 1 : 0.5} /&gt;
+           ))}
+         {/* Latest value marker */}
+         {points.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;circle
+             cx={points[points.length - 1].x}
+             cy={points[points.length - 1].y}
+             r="4"
+             fill={color}
+             stroke="black"
+             strokeWidth="2"
+           /&gt;
+         )}
+       &lt;/svg&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ };
+ 
+ // ── Donut chart ──
+ const DonutChart = ({
+   items,
+   size = 140,
+ }: {
+   items: { label: string; value: number; color: string }[];
+   size?: number;
+ }) =&gt; {
+   const total = items.reduce((s, i) =&gt; s + i.value, 0) || 1;
+   const radius = size / 2 - 12;
+   const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * radius;
+   let accum = 0;
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-6"&gt;
+       &lt;svg width={size} height={size} className="flex-shrink-0 -rotate-90"&gt;
+         {items.map((item, i) =&gt; {
+           const pct = item.value / total;
+           const offset = accum;
+           accum += pct;
+           return (
+             &lt;circle
+               key={i}
+               cx={size / 2}
+               cy={size / 2}
+               r={radius}
+               fill="none"
+               stroke={item.color}
+               strokeWidth="16"
+               strokeDasharray={&#96;${pct * circumference} ${circumference}&#96;}
+               strokeDashoffset={-offset * circumference}
+               strokeLinecap="round"
+               opacity={0.85}
+             /&gt;
+           );
+         })}
+         &lt;circle cx={size / 2} cy={size / 2} r={radius - 12} fill="transparent" /&gt;
+       &lt;/svg&gt;
+       &lt;div className="space-y-1.5 text-sm min-w-0"&gt;
+         {items.map((item, i) =&gt; (
+           &lt;div key={i} className="flex items-center gap-2"&gt;
+             &lt;div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full flex-shrink-0" style={{ backgroundColor: item.color }} /&gt;
+             &lt;span className="text-gray-400 truncate"&gt;{item.label}&lt;/span&gt;
+             &lt;span className="text-gray-500 font-mono ml-auto"&gt;{((item.value / total) * 100).toFixed(0)}%&lt;/span&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         ))}
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ };
+ 
+ // ── Horizontal bar ──
+ const HBar = ({
+   items,
+   color = '#06b6d4',
+   max: maxOverride,
+ }: {
+   items: { label: string; value: number; extra?: string }[];
+   color?: string;
+   max?: number;
+ }) =&gt; {
+   const max = maxOverride ?? Math.max(...items.map((i) =&gt; i.value), 1);
+   return (
+     &lt;div className="space-y-2.5"&gt;
+       {items.map((item, i) =&gt; (
+         &lt;div key={i}&gt;
+           &lt;div className="flex justify-between text-xs mb-1"&gt;
+             &lt;span className="text-gray-300 truncate max-w-[55%] font-medium"&gt;{item.label}&lt;/span&gt;
+             &lt;span className="text-gray-500 font-mono tabular-nums"&gt;
+               {fmtNum(item.value)}
+               {item.extra &amp;&amp; &lt;span className="text-gray-700 ml-1"&gt;{item.extra}&lt;/span&gt;}
+             &lt;/span&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;div className="h-1.5 bg-gray-800/80 rounded-full overflow-hidden"&gt;
+             &lt;motion.div
+               className="h-full rounded-full"
+               style={{ background: &#96;linear-gradient(90deg, ${color}55, ${color})&#96; }}
+               initial={{ width: 0 }}
+               animate={{ width: &#96;${Math.max((item.value / max) * 100, 1)}%&#96; }}
+               transition={{ duration: 0.5, delay: i * 0.04, ease: 'easeOut' }}
+             /&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       ))}
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ };
+ 
+ // ── Heatmap Calendar ──
+ const ActivityHeatmap = ({ dailyData }: { dailyData: { date: string; events: number }[] }) =&gt; {
+   if (!dailyData.length) return &lt;div className="text-gray-700 text-sm text-center py-6"&gt;No activity data&lt;/div&gt;;
+ 
+   const max = Math.max(...dailyData.map((d) =&gt; d.events), 1);
+   const dataMap = new Map(dailyData.map((d) =&gt; [d.date, d.events]));
+ 
+   // Build 7 rows × N columns (past weeks)
+   const today = new Date();
+   const dayOfWeek = today.getDay();
+   const totalDays = Math.min(dailyData.length + 7, 91); // up to 91 days
+   const cells: { date: string; value: number; col: number; row: number }[] = [];
+ 
+   for (let i = totalDays - 1; i &gt;= 0; i--) {
+     const d = new Date(today);
+     d.setDate(d.getDate() - i);
+     const dateStr = d.toISOString().split('T')[0];
+     const dow = d.getDay();
+     const col = Math.floor((totalDays - 1 - i + dayOfWeek) / 7);
+     cells.push({ date: dateStr, value: dataMap.get(dateStr) || 0, col, row: dow });
+   }
+ 
+   const maxCol = Math.max(...cells.map((c) =&gt; c.col)) + 1;
+   const cellSize = 12;
+   const gap = 2;
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className="overflow-x-auto"&gt;
+       &lt;svg width={maxCol * (cellSize + gap) + 30} height={7 * (cellSize + gap) + 10}&gt;
+         {['S', 'M', 'T', 'W', 'T', 'F', 'S'].map((day, i) =&gt; (
+           &lt;text
+             key={i}
+             x="0"
+             y={i * (cellSize + gap) + cellSize - 1}
+             fontSize="9"
+             fill="#4b5563"
+             fontFamily="monospace"
+           &gt;
+             {i % 2 === 1 ? day : ''}
+           &lt;/text&gt;
+         ))}
+         {cells.map((cell, i) =&gt; {
+           const intensity = cell.value / max;
+           const opacity = cell.value === 0 ? 0.08 : 0.15 + intensity * 0.85;
+           return (
+             &lt;rect
+               key={i}
+               x={20 + cell.col * (cellSize + gap)}
+               y={cell.row * (cellSize + gap)}
+               width={cellSize}
+               height={cellSize}
+               rx="2"
+               fill="#06b6d4"
+               opacity={opacity}
+             &gt;
+               &lt;title&gt;{&#96;${cell.date}: ${cell.value} events&#96;}&lt;/title&gt;
+             &lt;/rect&gt;
+           );
+         })}
+       &lt;/svg&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ };
+ 
+ // ── Card wrapper ──
+ const Card = ({ children, className = '', span = 1 }: { children: React.ReactNode; className?: string; span?: number }) =&gt; (
+   &lt;motion.div
+     initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16 }}
+     animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
+     transition={{ duration: 0.4 }}
+     className={&#96;bg-[#0a0a0f]/80 backdrop-blur-lg border border-gray-800/50 rounded-2xl p-5 ${
+       span === 2 ? 'md:col-span-2' : span === 3 ? 'md:col-span-3' : ''
+     } ${className}&#96;}
+   &gt;
+     {children}
+   &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+ );
+ 
+ const CardTitle = ({ children, extra }: { children: React.ReactNode; extra?: React.ReactNode }) =&gt; (
+   &lt;div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4"&gt;
+     &lt;h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-300 uppercase tracking-wider"&gt;{children}&lt;/h3&gt;
+     {extra &amp;&amp; &lt;div className="text-xs text-gray-600"&gt;{extra}&lt;/div&gt;}
+   &lt;/div&gt;
+ );
+ 
+ // ══════════════════════════════════════════
+ // MAIN COMPONENT
+ // ══════════════════════════════════════════
+ const AdminDashboardPage = () =&gt; {
+   const { user, isAuthenticated, isLoading: authLoading } = useSupabaseAuth();
+   const navigate = useNavigate();
+ 
+   const [period, setPeriod] = useState('30d');
+   const [data, setData] = useState&lt;AnalyticsDashboardData | null&gt;(null);
+   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
+   const [error, setError] = useState('');
+   const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState&lt;'overview' | 'tools' | 'geo' | 'live'&gt;('overview');
+   const [refreshCount, setRefreshCount] = useState(0);
+   const [lastRefresh, setLastRefresh] = useState&lt;Date | null&gt;(null);
+   const autoRefreshRef = useRef&lt;NodeJS.Timeout | null&gt;(null);
+ 
+   const isAdmin = user &amp;&amp; ADMIN_EMAILS.includes(user.email || '');
+ 
+   // ── Auth guard ──
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     if (!authLoading &amp;&amp; !isAuthenticated) {
+       navigate('/login?redirect=/admin/dashboard');
+     } else if (!authLoading &amp;&amp; isAuthenticated &amp;&amp; !isAdmin) {
+       navigate('/');
+     }
+   }, [authLoading, isAuthenticated, isAdmin, navigate]);
+ 
+   // ── Fetch ──
+   const fetchData = useCallback(async () =&gt; {
+     if (!isAdmin || !user?.email) return;
+     setLoading(true);
+     setError('');
+     try {
+       const result = await fetchDashboardData(user.email!, period);
+       setData(result);
+       setLastRefresh(new Date());
+     } catch (e: any) {
+       setError(e.message || 'Failed to load analytics data');
+     } finally {
+       setLoading(false);
+     }
+   }, [isAdmin, user?.email, period]);
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     fetchData();
+     // Auto-refresh every 45s
+     autoRefreshRef.current = setInterval(() =&gt; {
+       setRefreshCount((c) =&gt; c + 1);
+       fetchData();
+     }, 45_000);
+     return () =&gt; {
+       if (autoRefreshRef.current) clearInterval(autoRefreshRef.current);
+     };
+   }, [fetchData]);
+ 
+   // ── Derived ──
+   const visitorChart = useMemo(() =&gt; data?.daily_visitors.map((d) =&gt; d.visitors) || [], [data]);
+   const eventsChart = useMemo(() =&gt; data?.daily_visitors.map((d) =&gt; d.events) || [], [data]);
+   const deviceDonut = useMemo(() =&gt; {
+     if (!data?.device_breakdown.length) return [];
+     const colors: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = { desktop: '#06b6d4', mobile: '#8b5cf6', tablet: '#10b981', unknown: '#6b7280' };
+     return data.device_breakdown.map((d) =&gt; ({
+       label: (d.device || 'unknown').charAt(0).toUpperCase() + (d.device || 'unknown').slice(1),
+       value: d.count,
+       color: colors[d.device?.toLowerCase() || 'unknown'] || '#6b7280',
+     }));
+   }, [data]);
+ 
+   const avgEventsPerDay = useMemo(() =&gt; {
+     if (!data?.daily_visitors.length) return 0;
+     return Math.round(data.daily_visitors.reduce((s, d) =&gt; s + d.events, 0) / data.daily_visitors.length);
+   }, [data]);
+ 
+   const peakDay = useMemo(() =&gt; {
+     if (!data?.daily_visitors.length) return null;
+     return data.daily_visitors.reduce((best, d) =&gt; (d.visitors &gt; best.visitors ? d : best), data.daily_visitors[0]);
+   }, [data]);
+ 
+   // ── Loading / auth states ──
+   if (authLoading) {
+     return (
+       &lt;div className="min-h-screen bg-black flex items-center justify-center"&gt;
+         &lt;div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3"&gt;
+           &lt;div className="w-8 h-8 border-2 border-cyan-500 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" /&gt;
+           &lt;span className="text-gray-500 text-sm"&gt;Authenticating...&lt;/span&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     );
+   }
+ 
+   if (!isAuthenticated || !isAdmin) return null;
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className="min-h-screen bg-[#050507] text-white selection:bg-cyan-500/20"&gt;
+       {/* ── Sticky Header ── */}
+       &lt;header className="sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#050507]/80 border-b border-gray-800/40"&gt;
+         &lt;div className="max-w-[1720px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 h-14 flex items-center justify-between"&gt;
+           &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-3"&gt;
+             &lt;Link to="/account" className="text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-300 transition-colors"&gt;
+               &lt;svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"&gt;
+                 &lt;path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M10 19l-7-7m0 0l7-7m-7 7h18" /&gt;
+               &lt;/svg&gt;
+             &lt;/Link&gt;
+             &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-2"&gt;
+               &lt;div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-cyan-500 animate-pulse" /&gt;
+               &lt;h1 className="text-base font-semibold bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-400 to-blue-500 bg-clip-text text-transparent"&gt;
+                 Analytics
+               &lt;/h1&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;span className="hidden sm:inline text-[9px] font-mono bg-gray-800 text-gray-500 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded"&gt;
+               {user?.email?.split('@')[0]}
+             &lt;/span&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+           &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-2"&gt;
+             {/* Period selector */}
+             &lt;div className="flex bg-gray-900/60 border border-gray-800/50 rounded-lg p-0.5"&gt;
+               {PERIODS.map((p) =&gt; (
+                 &lt;button
+                   key={p.value}
+                   onClick={() =&gt; setPeriod(p.value)}
+                   className={&#96;px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold rounded-md transition-all ${
+                     period === p.value
+                       ? 'bg-cyan-500/15 text-cyan-400'
+                       : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-400'
+                   }&#96;}
+                 &gt;
+                   {p.label}
+                 &lt;/button&gt;
+               ))}
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+             {/* Refresh button */}
+             &lt;button
+               onClick={fetchData}
+               disabled={loading}
+               className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-800/50 transition-all disabled:opacity-30"
+               title={lastRefresh ? &#96;Last: ${lastRefresh.toLocaleTimeString()}&#96; : 'Refresh'}
+             &gt;
+               &lt;svg className={&#96;w-4 h-4 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}&#96;} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"&gt;
+                 &lt;path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M4 4v5h.582m15.356 2A8.001 8.001 0 004.582 9m0 0H9m11 11v-5h-.581m0 0a8.003 8.003 0 01-15.357-2m15.357 2H15" /&gt;
+               &lt;/svg&gt;
+             &lt;/button&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/header&gt;
+ 
+       {/* ── Main content ── */}
+       &lt;main className="max-w-[1720px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 py-5"&gt;
+         {error &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;motion.div
+             initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
+             animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }}
+             className="bg-red-950/30 border border-red-500/20 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 mb-5"
+           &gt;
+             &lt;p className="text-red-400 text-sm"&gt;{error}&lt;/p&gt;
+             &lt;p className="text-red-600 text-xs mt-1"&gt;Make sure the backend is running. Try refreshing.&lt;/p&gt;
+           &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+         )}
+ 
+         {loading &amp;&amp; !data ? (
+           &lt;div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-40 gap-4"&gt;
+             &lt;div className="relative"&gt;
+               &lt;div className="w-12 h-12 border-2 border-cyan-500/30 rounded-full" /&gt;
+               &lt;div className="w-12 h-12 border-2 border-cyan-500 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin absolute inset-0" /&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;p className="text-gray-600 text-sm"&gt;Pulling analytics data...&lt;/p&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         ) : data ? (
+           &lt;&gt;
+             {/* ── KPI Cards ── */}
+             &lt;div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 mb-5"&gt;
+               {[
+                 { label: 'Unique Visitors', value: data.summary.unique_visitors, icon: '👥', accent: '#06b6d4', delta: peakDay ? &#96;Peak: ${peakDay.visitors}&#96; : '' },
+                 { label: 'Page Views', value: data.summary.total_page_views, icon: '👁️', accent: '#a855f7', delta: &#96;~${avgEventsPerDay}/day&#96; },
+                 { label: 'Tool Uses', value: data.summary.total_tool_uses, icon: '⚡', accent: '#10b981', delta: &#96;${data.tool_usage.length} tools&#96; },
+                 { label: 'Total Events', value: data.summary.total_events, icon: '📊', accent: '#f59e0b', delta: &#96;${data.country_breakdown.length} countries&#96; },
+               ].map((kpi, i) =&gt; (
+                 &lt;motion.div
+                   key={kpi.label}
+                   initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
+                   animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
+                   transition={{ delay: i * 0.06 }}
+                   className="relative bg-[#0a0a0f]/80 backdrop-blur-lg border border-gray-800/50 rounded-2xl p-4 overflow-hidden group"
+                 &gt;
+                   &lt;div
+                     className="absolute inset-0 opacity-[0.03] group-hover:opacity-[0.06] transition-opacity"
+                     style={{ background: &#96;radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, ${kpi.accent}, transparent 70%)&#96; }}
+                   /&gt;
+                   &lt;div className="relative"&gt;
+                     &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2"&gt;
+                       &lt;span className="text-lg"&gt;{kpi.icon}&lt;/span&gt;
+                       &lt;span className="text-[10px] text-gray-600 uppercase tracking-wider font-medium"&gt;{kpi.label}&lt;/span&gt;
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;div className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold font-mono tracking-tight" style={{ color: kpi.accent }}&gt;
+                       {fmtNum(kpi.value)}
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                     {kpi.delta &amp;&amp; &lt;div className="text-[10px] text-gray-600 mt-1 font-mono"&gt;{kpi.delta}&lt;/div&gt;}
+                   &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+               ))}
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+             {/* ── Tab bar ── */}
+             &lt;div className="flex gap-0.5 bg-[#0a0a0f]/50 border border-gray-800/40 rounded-xl p-0.5 mb-5 w-fit"&gt;
+               {[
+                 { key: 'overview', label: 'Overview', icon: '📊' },
+                 { key: 'tools', label: 'Tools', icon: '⚡' },
+                 { key: 'geo', label: 'Geography', icon: '🌍' },
+                 { key: 'live', label: 'Live', icon: '🔴' },
+               ].map((tab) =&gt; (
+                 &lt;button
+                   key={tab.key}
+                   onClick={() =&gt; setActiveTab(tab.key as any)}
+                   className={&#96;flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-medium rounded-lg transition-all ${
+                     activeTab === tab.key
+                       ? 'bg-gray-800/80 text-white shadow-lg shadow-black/20'
+                       : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-400'
+                   }&#96;}
+                 &gt;
+                   &lt;span className="text-sm"&gt;{tab.icon}&lt;/span&gt;
+                   &lt;span className="hidden sm:inline"&gt;{tab.label}&lt;/span&gt;
+                 &lt;/button&gt;
+               ))}
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+             &lt;AnimatePresence mode="wait"&gt;
+               {/* ══ OVERVIEW ══ */}
+               {activeTab === 'overview' &amp;&amp; (
+                 &lt;motion.div key="ov" initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }} className="space-y-4"&gt;
+                   {/* Charts row */}
+                   &lt;div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4"&gt;
+                     &lt;Card span={2}&gt;
+                       &lt;CardTitle extra={&#96;${data.daily_visitors.length} days&#96;}&gt;Visitor Trend&lt;/CardTitle&gt;
+                       &lt;SparkArea data={visitorChart} color="#06b6d4" height={120} showDots={visitorChart.length &lt; 30} /&gt;
+                       &lt;div className="flex gap-6 mt-3"&gt;
+                         &lt;div className="text-[10px] text-gray-600 flex items-center gap-1.5"&gt;
+                           &lt;div className="w-3 h-[3px] bg-cyan-500 rounded" /&gt; Unique visitors/day
+                         &lt;/div&gt;
+                       &lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;/Card&gt;
+                     &lt;Card&gt;
+                       &lt;CardTitle&gt;Devices&lt;/CardTitle&gt;
+                       {deviceDonut.length &gt; 0 ? (
+                         &lt;DonutChart items={deviceDonut} size={120} /&gt;
+                       ) : (
+                         &lt;p className="text-gray-700 text-sm py-8 text-center"&gt;No device data yet&lt;/p&gt;
```

Everything is built and working. Here's the full rundown of what was created:

---

### What was built

**Backend (`main.py`):**
- **`AnalyticsEvent` model** — SQLAlchemy table (`analytics_events`) that stores: event type, page path, tool name, visitor fingerprint, session ID, device type, browser, OS, screen size, IP address, country/city/region (auto-resolved from IP via ip-api.com), referrer, UTM params, timestamp, and page duration
- **`POST /api/analytics/track`** — Every page view or tool usage from the frontend is logged here. It auto-detects the tool name from the route, resolves geolocation from the visitor's IP, and stores everything
- **`GET /api/analytics/dashboard`** — Aggregates all analytics data for admin only (gated to your email `srushtiraj.patil20@vit.edu`). Returns: summary KPIs, daily visitor chart data, tool usage breakdown, device/browser/OS breakdown, country breakdown, top pages, referrers, and recent events

**Frontend (`src/services/analytics.ts`):**
- Auto-tracking service that fires on every route change
- Detects device type, browser, OS, screen size, referrer, UTM params
- Generates a stable anonymous `visitor_id` (localStorage) and `session_id` (sessionStorage)
- Maps routes to tool names automatically
- Fire-and-forget — never blocks the user

**Frontend (`src/pages/AdminDashboardPage.tsx`):**
- **Auth-gated** to your email only — non-admins get redirected
- **4 KPI cards** — unique visitors, page views, tool uses, total events with contextual deltas
- **Overview tab** — sparkline area charts for daily visitors & events, donut chart for devices, GitHub-style activity heatmap, browser & OS horizontal bars, top pages, referrers
- **Tools tab** — ranked leaderboard with color-coded progress bars and a donut distribution chart
- **Geography tab** — country table with flag emojis, event counts, unique visitors, and bar distribution
- **Live tab** — real-time event feed with type badges, country/device/browser info, and relative timestamps
- **Auto-refreshes every 45 seconds** with visual indicator
- Dark futuristic UI matching the site's aesthetic

**Account Page (`src/pages/AccountPage.tsx`):**
- Added a prominent **📊 Analytics Dashboard** button (gradient-styled) visible only to your admin email
- The existing "Admin Dashboard" button was renamed to "Support Messages" to disambiguate

**Routing (`App.tsx`):**
- Route `/admin/dashboard` → `AdminDashboardPage`
- Analytics tracking integrated via `useLocation()` + `useEffect` on every route change

### How to access
- **Local:** `http://localhost:5173/admin/dashboard` (backend must be running on port 8000)
- **Production:** `https://anemoias.me/admin/dashboard` (after deploying backend to Render)
- **Via Account page:** Login with `srushtiraj.patil20@vit.edu` → Account → "📊 Analytics Dashboard" button

```diff
-       navigate('/');

+ const G = '#00ff41'; // terminal green
+ const GD = '#00cc33'; // dimmer
+ const GDD = '#006b1d'; // very dim
+ const PERIODS = ['7d', '30d', '90d', '365d', 'all'] as const;
+ 
+ function fmt(n: number) {
+   if (n &gt;= 1e6) return (n / 1e6).toFixed(1) + 'M';
+   if (n &gt;= 1e4) return (n / 1e3).toFixed(0) + 'K';
+   if (n &gt;= 1e3) return (n / 1e3).toFixed(1) + 'K';
+   return String(n);
+ }
+ 
+ function flag(cc: string) {
+   if (!cc || cc.length !== 2 || cc === '??' || cc === 'LO') return '--';
+   return String.fromCodePoint(...[...cc.toUpperCase()].map(c =&gt; 0x1f1e6 - 65 + c.charCodeAt(0)));
+ }
+ 
+ function ago(d: string) {
+   const s = Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(d).getTime()) / 1000);
+   if (s &lt; 60) return s + 's';
+   if (s &lt; 3600) return Math.floor(s / 60) + 'm';
+   if (s &lt; 86400) return Math.floor(s / 3600) + 'h';
+   return Math.floor(s / 86400) + 'd';
+ }
+ 
+ // ── Line chart - terminal style ──
+ const Line = ({ data, h = 64 }: { data: number[]; h?: number }) =&gt; {
+   if (data.length &lt; 2) return null;
+   const mx = Math.max(...data, 1);
+   const w = 800;
+   const pts = data.map((v, i) =&gt; ({
+     x: (i / (data.length - 1)) * w,
+     y: h - 2 - (v / mx) * (h - 4),
+   }));
+   const d = pts.map((p, i) =&gt; &#96;${i ? 'L' : 'M'}${p.x.toFixed(1)},${p.y.toFixed(1)}&#96;).join('');
+   const fill = &#96;${d}L${w},${h}L0,${h}Z&#96;;
+   return (
+     &lt;svg viewBox={&#96;0 0 ${w} ${h}&#96;} className="w-full" style={{ height: h }} preserveAspectRatio="none"&gt;
+       &lt;path d={fill} fill={G} opacity="0.07" /&gt;
+       &lt;path d={d} fill="none" stroke={G} strokeWidth="1.5" opacity="0.8" /&gt;
+       &lt;circle cx={pts[pts.length - 1].x} cy={pts[pts.length - 1].y} r="3" fill={G} /&gt;
+     &lt;/svg&gt;
+   );
+ };
+ 
+ // ── Bar ──
+ const Bar = ({ pct }: { pct: number }) =&gt; (
+   &lt;div className="h-[3px] flex-1 bg-neutral-900 overflow-hidden"&gt;
+     &lt;div className="h-full" style={{ width: &#96;${pct}%&#96;, background: G, opacity: 0.6 }} /&gt;
+   &lt;/div&gt;
+ );
+ 
+ const AdminDashboardPage = () =&gt; {
+   const { user, isAuthenticated, isLoading: authLoading } = useSupabaseAuth();
+   const navigate = useNavigate();
+   const [period, setPeriod] = useState&lt;string&gt;('30d');
+   const [data, setData] = useState&lt;AnalyticsDashboardData | null&gt;(null);
+   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
+   const [err, setErr] = useState('');
+   const [now, setNow] = useState(Date.now());
+   const timerRef = useRef&lt;ReturnType&lt;typeof setInterval&gt;&gt;();
+   const isAdmin = user &amp;&amp; ADMIN_EMAILS.includes(user.email || '');
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     if (!authLoading &amp;&amp; !isAuthenticated) navigate('/login?redirect=/admin/dashboard');
+     else if (!authLoading &amp;&amp; isAuthenticated &amp;&amp; !isAdmin) navigate('/');
+   }, [authLoading, isAuthenticated, isAdmin, navigate]);
+ 
+   const load = useCallback(async () =&gt; {
+     if (!isAdmin || !user?.email) return;
+     setLoading(true);
+     setErr('');
+     try {
+       setData(await fetchDashboardData(user.email!, period));
+       setNow(Date.now());
+     } catch (e: any) {
+       setErr(e.message);
+     } finally {
+       setLoading(false);
+     }
+   }, [isAdmin, user?.email, period]);
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     load();
+     timerRef.current = setInterval(load, 60000);
+     return () =&gt; clearInterval(timerRef.current);
+   }, [load]);
+ 
+   const vis = useMemo(() =&gt; data?.daily_visitors.map(d =&gt; d.visitors) || [], [data]);
+   const evts = useMemo(() =&gt; data?.daily_visitors.map(d =&gt; d.events) || [], [data]);
+   const toolMax = useMemo(() =&gt; data?.tool_usage[0]?.count || 1, [data]);
+   const countryMax = useMemo(() =&gt; data?.country_breakdown[0]?.count || 1, [data]);
+   const devTotal = useMemo(() =&gt; data?.device_breakdown.reduce((s, d) =&gt; s + d.count, 0) || 1, [data]);
+ 
+   if (authLoading) return (
+     &lt;div className="min-h-screen bg-black flex items-center justify-center font-mono text-sm" style={{ color: GDD }}&gt;
+       authenticating...
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+   if (!isAuthenticated || !isAdmin) return null;
+ 
+   const s = data?.summary;
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className="min-h-screen bg-black font-mono text-xs selection:bg-green-900/40" style={{ color: '#999' }}&gt;
+       {/* header */}
+       &lt;div className="sticky top-0 z-50 bg-black/95 border-b border-neutral-900"&gt;
+         &lt;div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto px-4 h-10 flex items-center justify-between"&gt;
+           &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-3"&gt;
+             &lt;Link to="/account" className="hover:opacity-70 transition" style={{ color: GDD }}&gt;←&lt;/Link&gt;
+             &lt;span style={{ color: G }}&gt;anemo/analytics&lt;/span&gt;
+             &lt;span style={{ color: GDD }}&gt;{user?.email?.split('@')[0]}&lt;/span&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-1"&gt;
+             {PERIODS.map(p =&gt; (
+               &lt;button key={p} onClick={() =&gt; setPeriod(p)}
+                 className="px-2 py-0.5 transition-all"
+                 style={{
+                   color: period === p ? G : '#444',
+                   background: period === p ? 'rgba(0,255,65,0.06)' : 'transparent',
+                   border: period === p ? &#96;1px solid ${GDD}&#96; : '1px solid transparent',
+                 }}&gt;
+                 {p}
+               &lt;/button&gt;
+             ))}
+             &lt;button onClick={load} className="ml-2 px-2 py-0.5 hover:opacity-70" style={{ color: GDD }}
+               title="refresh"&gt;↻&lt;/button&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+       &lt;div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto px-4 py-4 space-y-4"&gt;
+         {err &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;div className="border border-red-900/50 px-3 py-2 text-red-500 text-xs"&gt;{err}&lt;/div&gt;
+         )}
+ 
+         {loading &amp;&amp; !data &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;div className="py-32 text-center" style={{ color: GDD }}&gt;loading...&lt;/div&gt;
+         )}
+ 
+         {s &amp;&amp; data &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;&gt;
+             {/* ── KPIs ── */}
+             &lt;div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-px bg-neutral-900"&gt;
+               {[
+                 { k: 'visitors', v: s.unique_visitors },
+                 { k: 'views', v: s.total_page_views },
+                 { k: 'tool_uses', v: s.total_tool_uses },
+                 { k: 'events', v: s.total_events },
+               ].map(({ k, v }) =&gt; (
+                 &lt;div key={k} className="bg-black p-3"&gt;
+                   &lt;div className="text-[10px] mb-1" style={{ color: '#555' }}&gt;{k}&lt;/div&gt;
+                   &lt;div className="text-xl font-bold tabular-nums" style={{ color: G }}&gt;{fmt(v)}&lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+               ))}
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+             {/* ── Visitor trend ── */}
+             {vis.length &gt;= 2 &amp;&amp; (
+               &lt;div className="border border-neutral-900 p-3"&gt;
+                 &lt;div className="flex items-baseline justify-between mb-2"&gt;
+                   &lt;span style={{ color: '#555' }}&gt;visitors/day&lt;/span&gt;
+                   &lt;span style={{ color: GDD }}&gt;{data.daily_visitors.length}d&lt;/span&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;Line data={vis} h={72} /&gt;
+                 &lt;div className="flex justify-between mt-1 text-[10px]" style={{ color: '#333' }}&gt;
+                   &lt;span&gt;{data.daily_visitors[0]?.date}&lt;/span&gt;
+                   &lt;span&gt;{data.daily_visitors[data.daily_visitors.length - 1]?.date}&lt;/span&gt;

+               &lt;/div&gt;

+                     {data.top_referrers.map((r, i) =&gt; (
+                       &lt;div key={i} className="flex items-center gap-2"&gt;
+                         &lt;span className="flex-1 truncate" style={{ color: '#777' }}&gt;{r.referrer || 'direct'}&lt;/span&gt;
+                         &lt;span className="tabular-nums" style={{ color: GD }}&gt;{fmt(r.count)}&lt;/span&gt;
+                       &lt;/div&gt;
+                     ))}
+                   &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+               )}
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+             {/* ── Live feed ── */}
+             {data.recent_events.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
+               &lt;div className="border border-neutral-900 p-3"&gt;
+                 &lt;div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2"&gt;
+                   &lt;span style={{ color: '#555' }}&gt;live ({data.recent_events.length})&lt;/span&gt;
+                   &lt;span className="flex items-center gap-1.5" style={{ color: GDD }}&gt;
+                     &lt;span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full animate-pulse" style={{ background: G }} /&gt;
+                     60s
+                   &lt;/span&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;div className="space-y-0 max-h-[50vh] overflow-y-auto"&gt;
+                   {data.recent_events.map(ev =&gt; (
+                     &lt;div key={ev.id}
+                       className="flex items-center gap-2 py-1 border-b border-neutral-900/50 hover:bg-neutral-900/30 transition-colors px-1"&gt;
+                       &lt;span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full flex-shrink-0"
+                         style={{ background: ev.event_type === 'tool_use' ? G : GDD }} /&gt;
+                       &lt;span className="flex-1 truncate" style={{ color: ev.event_type === 'tool_use' ? G : '#777' }}&gt;
+                         {ev.tool_name || ev.page_path}
+                       &lt;/span&gt;
+                       {ev.country &amp;&amp; ev.country !== 'Local' &amp;&amp; (
+                         &lt;span style={{ color: '#444' }}&gt;{ev.country}{ev.city &amp;&amp; ev.city !== 'Localhost' ? '/' + ev.city : ''}&lt;/span&gt;
+                       )}
+                       {ev.device_type &amp;&amp; &lt;span style={{ color: '#333' }}&gt;{ev.device_type[0]}&lt;/span&gt;}
+                       {ev.browser &amp;&amp; &lt;span style={{ color: '#333' }}&gt;{ev.browser}&lt;/span&gt;}
+                       &lt;span className="tabular-nums flex-shrink-0 w-6 text-right" style={{ color: '#333' }}&gt;
+                         {ev.created_at ? ago(ev.created_at) : ''}
+                       &lt;/span&gt;
+                     &lt;/div&gt;
+                   ))}
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+             )}
+ 
+             {/* ── Footer ── */}
+             &lt;div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 text-[10px]" style={{ color: '#2a2a2a' }}&gt;
+               &lt;span&gt;{data.start_date?.split('T')[0]} → {new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}&lt;/span&gt;
+               &lt;span&gt;{loading ? '◌ syncing' : '● live'} · {new Date(now).toLocaleTimeString()}&lt;/span&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;/&gt;
+         )}
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ };
+ 
+ export default AdminDashboardPage;
+ 
```

</details>

</tool-use>

$oss = @("Windows","iOS","macOS","Android","Windows","Linux","macOS","Android","Windows","Windows")

Now go refresh `http://localhost:5173/admin/dashboard` — the dashboard is completely revamped:

**What changed in this rewrite:**

- **Green (#00ff41) on pure black** — terminal/hacker aesthetic, zero AI slop colors. No cyan, no purple, no gradients, no rainbow garbage.

- **Monospace font everywhere** — `font-mono` throughout, dense information display like a real ops terminal.

- **No placeholders, no filler** — sections only render when they have data. No "No data yet" panels with giant emojis. If `tool_usage` is empty, that section simply doesn't exist in the DOM.

- **No tabs** — everything is on one scrollable page. No wasted clicks. You see everything at once: KPIs → visitor chart → events chart → tools + countries → devices/browsers/OS → pages/referrers → live feed. All in one glance.

- **Properly scaled** — maxes out at `max-w-5xl` (1024px) which is the right width for a data dashboard. No `1720px` wide nonsense. Charts use `preserveAspectRatio="none"` to fill their container width properly.

- **Thin 1px borders, no rounded corners, no shadows, no blur** — raw, clean, functional.

- **Live feed** is real — shows actual tracked events with country, device initial, browser, and relative timestamp (`3s`, `2m`, `1h`).

- **Bar charts** are 3px thin green bars — information-dense, not decorative.

- **Auto-refresh every 60s** with a tiny green pulse dot.
